message: Thanks for opening this standing agreement. Our proposal is $6.30 per unit, lots of 20 to 100 units, 40% paid at shipment and 60% on receipt, a 28-day lead time with a 4-day grace period, a 0.5% price cut per late day capped at 3%, a 10-day cancel window, and a 3-day deemed-acceptance window. We are happy to talk through anything that matters to you.
